_comment: The structure of the registry. You do not normally write this manually. Use `smart-router add-mcp`, `add-skill`, or `migrate`, or the `admin` MCP tool. Writes go to $SMART_ROUTER_CONFIG, $SMART_ROUTER_HOME/config.json, or ~/.config/smart-router/config.json. Writes do not go to the current directory. smart-router ignores an unknown key like this one.
